# Operator Upgrade Notes

- Use [operator-upgrade-notes](../skills/operator-upgrade-notes/SKILL.md) when
  assessing upgrade impact or writing notes; apply its Operational Relevance
  test before selecting note triggers.
- Write required guidance under `## Unreleased`, grouped by descriptive ### headings.
- Keep exactly one leading Unreleased section; allow it to be empty.
- Preserve existing source-marker comments and release history when correcting content.
